text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, are you really doing this?
If you hate it, there's nothing wrong with just hating it."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, a princess must always be kind to animals!
I shall overcome my hatred of frogs through sheer grit...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Longing for the 'Frog Prince,' I searched for a frog,
and caught it with my face... in my childhood days."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Back then, it was so slimy and completely different from the picture books that
I fainted, but—now, I'm sure I can...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Come now, bring out your familiar at once!
T-T-T-Today is the day
I finally poke it...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, hold on, let me open the basket...
Whoa—!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: N-N-No way, it's totally impossible for meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Kawakami!? Hey! I told you it's already come off~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*...!
Oh? My body feels kinda light somehow...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it,
the frog was gone...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I couldn't poke it, but
I think we got a little closer...! Maybe!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, where is this?
Just how far did I run...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Kawakami Princess managed to return from the unfamiliar place all on her own.
All that running around supposedly caused her to lose a lot of weight...
